instruction:
Modify the provided Word documents according to the following requirements:
1. Delete the content under "Lesson Learning Objectives" and "Lesson Assessment Tasks" (but keep the headings).
2. Delete all content in the three sections "Analysis of Lesson Learning Content," "Students' Actual Proficiency Level for the Lesson," and "Explanation of Activity Intent" (including the headings), as well as all images, and move the table upward.
3. Delete the parenthetical content after each stage (indicating which objective it aligns with).
4. Add the title "III. Learning Process Design" to the table on the second page; renumber "Board Plan" as IV and "Teaching Reflection" as V.
5. Condense all content into a two-page document. Keep the text and images unchanged, and adjust only the font size, line spacing, and spacing between images and text.

dim1: The delivered files are in Word format, have the .doc extension, and can be opened normally.

The delivered Word files retain the main structure of the Lesson Learning Plan, and content related to Lesson Topic, Lesson Type, Learning Process Design, Board Plan, and Teaching Reflection can be found.
